lineup: Create ref_heavy_defense_lineup_01.png, a master visual reference lineup for Border Defenders. Inputs are style references: approved Danube master and integrated gameplay screenshot. Four distinct military emplacements on a quiet muted olive background in a 2x2 layout: Mortar Position (sandbag ring and mortar tube), Flamethrower Position (compact concrete base with twin fuel tanks and nozzle), Auto Cannon (heavy olive cannon with ammunition feed on square reinforced sandbags), Rocket Launcher (rotating paired launch tubes on compact concrete pad). STRICT perpendicular top-down orthographic overhead, see roofs and top surfaces only, no front facades, no isometric or 3/4 perspective. All aim toward LEFT. Gritty post-nuclear Balkan military pixel art, broad deliberate crisp pixel clusters, muted olive #636B44 steel #5A615D rust #7F4833 sandbags bone #C1B19E shadow #1F292C. Match 64 logical pixels per grid cell; heavy structures roughly 2x2 cells, flame 1x1. Minimal compact contact shading, upper-left highlights, NO long cast shadows. No people, no text, no UI, no flames permanently baked into structures. Clearly separate silhouettes.

records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent production sprite source sheet for mortar emplacement matching the reference lineup upper-left design exactly. Eight cells in row-major order: (1) stationary BASE ONLY with weapon removed; (2) independently rotating WEAPON ONLY idle; (3) weapon-only firing frame 1; (4) weapon-only firing frame 2; (5) weapon-only firing frame 3; (6) weapon-only firing frame 4; (7) DAMAGED BASE ONLY; (8) DESTROYED BASE wreck ONLY.
